item.title: Efficient Algorithms for Rotating 2D Arrays and Matrices
item.description:
“Efficient Algorithms for Rotating 2D Arrays and Matrices”

How does one programmatically achieve rotation of a 2D array or matrix, considering operations like 90 degrees clockwise (+90), 90 degrees counter-clockwise (-90), and 180 degrees, while balancing time complexity ($O(N^2)$) and space complexity (especially aiming for $O(1)$ in-place manipulation)?

Various expert solutions present distinct approaches, often focused on square matrices ($N \times N$) but sometimes adaptable to rectangular ones ($M \times N$).
